description: This file is a PHP class defining a controller for managing 'Return Status' entities within the Opencart e-commerce platform's admin panel. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, saving, and deleting return statuses, handling HTTP requests, and rendering views for return status management.

classes.name: ReturnStatus
classes.description: Controller class for managing return statuses, extending the core Controller class, providing CRUD operations, view rendering, and handling permissions within the Opencart admin environment.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point to display the return status list page, prepares data, and loads the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to retrieve the list of return statuses.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for the list of return statuses, including pagination and action links.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a return status, loading existing data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submission to create or update a return status, with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected return statuses, with checks for default status and existing dependencies.
